jp: \t\t生化学文明末期に製造された水筒。高度ろ過機構を搭載しており、汚染された水も量さえ用意できればどうにか飲めるようにできる。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生化学文明末期に製造された水筒。高度ろ過機構を搭載しており、汚染された水も量さえ用意できればどうにか飲めるようにできる。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"

jp: \t\t神の力を宿した手。かつて同じ力を手にしたロバ耳の黄金王が、愛の力で悲劇を打ち破った話はあまりにも有名。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神の力を宿した手。かつて同じ力を手にしたロバ耳の黄金王が、愛の力で悲劇を打ち破った話はあまりにも有名。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: The hand that holds the power of God. The story of the Golden King of Donkey Ears, who once held the same power in his hands, who defeated tragedy with the power of love, is all too well known. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "The hand that holds the power of God. The story of the Golden King of Donkey Ears, who once held the same power in his hands, who defeated tragedy with the power of love, is all too well known. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una mano in cui alberga la forza di un dio. È fin troppo nota la storia del re d'oro dalle orecchie d'asino che, avendo un tempo avuto in mano la stessa forza, spezzò la tragedia con la forza dell'amore. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t光子で構成された巡回プログラム。光速で飛び回って情報を収集したり逆に情報を広めたりする。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t光子で構成された巡回プログラム。光速で飛び回って情報を収集したり逆に情報を広めたりする。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Patrol program composed of photons. It flies around at the speed of light to collect information or, conversely, to spread information. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Patrol program composed of photons. It flies around at the speed of light to collect information or, conversely, to spread information. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un programma di pattuglia fatto di fotoni. Vola in giro alla velocità della luce e raccoglie informazioni, oppure al contrario le diffonde. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t神々しい勲章。自分を貫き通す強さと、自分さえ捨ててまで守るべきものを守り通す強さを象徴する。強い力を秘めているが、よく考えて使わないと何も守れず何も貫けずに死ぬことになる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神々しい勲章。自分を貫き通す強さと、自分さえ捨ててまで守るべきものを守り通す強さを象徴する。強い力を秘めているが、よく考えて使わないと何も守れず何も貫けずに死ぬことになる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Divine medal of honor. It symbolizes the strength to carry oneself through and the strength to protect what needs to be protected, even to the point of abandoning oneself. It has strong power, but if you don't use it thoughtfully, you will die without being able to protect or carry through anything. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Divine medal of honor. It symbolizes the strength to carry oneself through and the strength to protect what needs to be protected, even to the point of abandoning oneself. It has strong power, but if you don't use it thoughtfully, you will die without being able to protect or carry through anything. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una medaglia divina. Simboleggia due forze: quella di tenere fede a sé stessi fino in fondo e quella di difendere fino in fondo ciò che va difeso, anche a costo di rinunciare a sé. Racchiude un gran potere, ma se non la si usa con giudizio si finisce col morire senza aver difeso né tenuto fede a niente. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t神が用意した許可証。現代イルヴァにおいては、まず仲間関係にならなければ結婚は許可されない。しかしこれを突きつければ、結婚が可能になるのだ。もちろん相手には断る権利があるのだが。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t神が用意した許可証。現代イルヴァにおいては、まず仲間関係にならなければ結婚は許可されない。しかしこれを突きつければ、結婚が可能になるのだ。もちろん相手には断る権利があるのだが。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A license prepared by God. In modern Irva, marriage is not permitted without first becoming partners. However, if the couple confronts the marriage partner with this, the marriage is possible. Of course, the other party has the right to refuse. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A license prepared by God. In modern Irva, marriage is not permitted without first becoming partners. However, if the couple confronts the marriage partner with this, the marriage is possible. Of course, the other party has the right to refuse. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un permesso preparato da un dio. Nell'Irva di oggi non ci si può sposare se prima non si è compagni. Ma sbattendo in faccia questo foglio il matrimonio diventa possibile. Certo, l'altro ha sempre il diritto di dire di no. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t空間潜航している浮遊要塞を呼び寄せるアクセスキー。ただし何らかの改造を施されており、明らかに規格外の電子部品が外付けされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t空間潜航している浮遊要塞を呼び寄せるアクセスキー。ただし何らかの改造を施されており、明らかに規格外の電子部品が外付けされている。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: An access key that calls up a floating fortress in spatial submergence. However, it has been modified in some way, with obviously non-standard electronic components attached externally. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "An access key that calls up a floating fortress in spatial submergence. However, it has been modified in some way, with obviously non-standard electronic components attached externally. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: La chiave d'accesso che richiama la fortezza volante immersa nello spazio. Qualcuno però l'ha modificata: ci sono attaccati fuori dei pezzi elettronici palesemente fuori standard. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t守護者の体内から見つかる謎の結晶。記憶と化合することで力を生み出すという。ネフィア症候群の末期患者を解剖したところ、体内に同様の結晶が形成されつつあったという記録もある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t守護者の体内から見つかる謎の結晶。記憶と化合することで力を生み出すという。ネフィア症候群の末期患者を解剖したところ、体内に同様の結晶が形成されつつあったという記録もある。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Mysterious crystals found inside a Nefia guardian's body. It is said to generate power by compounding with memories. Similar crystals were reportedly found inside the bodies of patients suffering from Nephia Syndrome. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Mysterious crystals found inside a Nefia guardian's body. It is said to generate power by compounding with memories. Similar crystals were reportedly found inside the bodies of patients suffering from Nephia Syndrome. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un cristallo misterioso che si trova nel corpo dei guardiani. Dicono che generi forza combinandosi con la memoria. C'è anche un referto di quando fu aperto il corpo di un malato terminale di sindrome di Nefia: dentro gli si stava formando un cristallo uguale. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

en: It seems that if the relevant skill is too low, it cannot be converted into a bonus and the skill itself will be gone. There is no such thing as an unnecessary skill, so it seems difficult to utilize. \n# ~memo of a grave robber~
en_grezzo: "It seems that if the relevant skill is too low, it cannot be converted into a bonus and the skill itself will be gone. There is no such thing as an unnecessary skill, so it seems difficult to utilize. \n# ~memo of a grave robber~"
it: Pare che se l'abilità in questione è troppo bassa non si converta in bonus e sparisca del tutto. E siccome abilità inutili non ce ne sono, sfruttarlo sembra difficile. \n# ~Appunti di un Predone di Rovine~

jp: \t\t様々な計器やパネル、液晶がついたボード。全ての機能を扱いこなすには、高い情報処理能力が求められる。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n

en_grezzo: "Board with various instruments, panels, and LCDs. A high level of information processing capability is required to handle all the functions. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~"
it: Un pannello con sopra strumenti di misura, quadri e schermi a cristalli liquidi. Per usarne bene tutte le funzioni ci vuole una gran capacità di elaborare informazioni. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\t守護者となってしまった者が遺す破片。ネフィアから与えられた知識や過去の技術、守護者自身の記憶などがかすかに宿っている。技術や知識を吸収することができるが、他人の記憶が流れ込んでくるので気が狂いそうになる。もしもネフィア症候群の末期患者が使った場合、意識を失い、新たなネフィアの守護者となってしまうだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t守護者となってしまった者が遺す破片。ネフィアから与えられた知識や過去の技術、守護者自身の記憶などがかすかに宿っている。技術や知識を吸収することができるが、他人の記憶が流れ込んでくるので気が狂いそうになる。もしもネフィア症候群の末期患者が使った場合、意識を失い、新たなネフィアの守護者となってしまうだろう。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: These are treasures that provide experience, or even knowledge of the skill. In rare cases, some people are incapable of acquiring skills this way due to body rejection? \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "These are treasures that provide experience, or even knowledge of the skill. In rare cases, some people are incapable of acquiring skills this way due to body rejection? \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: I detriti che lascia chi è diventato guardiano. Ci abita ancora un poco del sapere che la Nefia gli ha dato, delle tecniche di un tempo, dei ricordi del guardiano stesso. Se ne possono assorbire tecniche e sapere, ma insieme entra la memoria di un altro e c'è da uscire di senno. E se li usasse un malato terminale di sindrome di Nefia, perderebbe conoscenza e diventerebbe lui il nuovo guardiano della Nefia. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: 持っているスキルなら経験を得られ、持っていないスキルなら習得することができるお宝だ。まれに拒絶反応でスキルを習得できない体質のやつもいるらしいが、本当だろうか。\n#～遺跡荒らしのメモ～
jp_grezzo: "持っているスキルなら経験を得られ、持っていないスキルなら習得することができるお宝だ。まれに拒絶反応でスキルを習得できない体質のやつもいるらしいが、本当だろうか。\n#～遺跡荒らしのメモ～"
en: It seems that if the relevant skill is too low, it cannot be converted into a bonus and the skill itself will be gone. There is no such thing as an unnecessary skill, so it seems difficult to utilize. \n# ~memo of a grave robber~
en_grezzo: "It seems that if the relevant skill is too low, it cannot be converted into a bonus and the skill itself will be gone. There is no such thing as an unnecessary skill, so it seems difficult to utilize. \n# ~memo of a grave robber~"
it: Un tesoro che, se l'abilità già ce l'hai, ti dà esperienza, e se non ce l'hai te la fa imparare. Pare che di rado ci sia chi per rigetto non riesce a impararle: sarà vero? \n# ~Appunti di un Predone di Rovine~

jp: \t\t「抵抗力のある者であればネフィアに取り込まれず、記憶片を集めて強くなれる。何事にも穴はあるものだ。…いや待てよ。抵抗力のある者に力を集中させることが本来の目的だとしたら…？」\n#～遺跡研究者『メローキア』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「抵抗力のある者であればネフィアに取り込まれず、記憶片を集めて強くなれる。何事にも穴はあるものだ。…いや待てよ。抵抗力のある者に力を集中させることが本来の目的だとしたら…？」\n#～遺跡研究者『メローキア』の言葉～\n"
en: \"Those who are resistant won't be taken in by Nefia and can gather memory fragments to make them stronger. There are loopholes in everything. ...No, wait. What if the original purpose of this item is to concentrate power on those who are resistant?\" \n# ~words of <Melochea> the Nefia Researcher~
en_grezzo: "\"Those who are resistant won't be taken in by Nefia and can gather memory fragments to make them stronger. There are loopholes in everything. ...No, wait. What if the original purpose of this item is to concentrate power on those who are resistant?\" \n# ~words of <Melochea> the Nefia Researcher~"
it: \"Chi ha resistenza non viene inghiottito dalla Nefia e può farsi forte raccogliendo detriti. Una falla c'è sempre, in ogni cosa. ...No, aspetta. E se lo scopo vero fosse proprio concentrare la forza su chi resiste...?\" \n# ~Parole di <Melochea>, studiosa di rovine~

jp: \t\t古来より忍者が使用・発展させてきた煙幕発生装置。旧式は火をつける必要があったが、現代のものは着火不要になっている。投げると煙幕を展開して視界を遮断する。煙幕はほとんどの遠距離攻撃を妨げるため、その隙に逃げたり奇襲して各個撃破したりできる。忍術の中にはこれを用いず、自力で煙を発生させる流派もあるのだとか。\n#～図解・忍者のひみつ１００選～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t古来より忍者が使用・発展させてきた煙幕発生装置。旧式は火をつける必要があったが、現代のものは着火不要になっている。投げると煙幕を展開して視界を遮断する。煙幕はほとんどの遠距離攻撃を妨げるため、その隙に逃げたり奇襲して各個撃破したりできる。忍術の中にはこれを用いず、自力で煙を発生させる流派もあるのだとか。\n#～図解・忍者のひみつ１００選～\n"
en: Smoke screen generators have been used and developed by the ninja since ancient times. Older models required a fire to be lit, but modern ones no longer require ignition. When thrown, it deploys a smoke screen to block vision. The smoke screen blocks most long-range attacks, allowing the ninja to escape or surprise the enemy and destroy them individually. Some schools of ninjutsu do not use this method, but instead generate smoke by themselves. \n# ~100 Secret of the Ninja - Illustrated~
en_grezzo: "Smoke screen generators have been used and developed by the ninja since ancient times. Older models required a fire to be lit, but modern ones no longer require ignition. When thrown, it deploys a smoke screen to block vision. The smoke screen blocks most long-range attacks, allowing the ninja to escape or surprise the enemy and destroy them individually. Some schools of ninjutsu do not use this method, but instead generate smoke by themselves. \n# ~100 Secret of the Ninja - Illustrated~"
it: Un apparecchio che genera cortine di fumo, usato e affinato dai ninja fin dall'antichità. I modelli vecchi andavano accesi, quelli di oggi no. Lanciandolo stende una cortina che toglie la vista. La cortina ferma quasi tutti gli attacchi da lontano, e in quel varco si può fuggire oppure piombare addosso al nemico e farlo fuori uno per volta. Dicono che fra le arti ninja ci sia anche qualche scuola che il fumo se lo fa da sé, senza questo. \n# ~Illustrato: Cento Segreti del Ninja~

jp: \t\t富の女神が発行しているカード。商人の保護・育成と経済活動促進を目的としているらしい。店の売り上げと客入りに応じてヤカポイントが加算されていく。ポイントは１０万が上限なので適度に使おう。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t富の女神が発行しているカード。商人の保護・育成と経済活動促進を目的としているらしい。店の売り上げと客入りに応じてヤカポイントが加算されていく。ポイントは１０万が上限なので適度に使おう。\n#～脱冒険者から始める商いライフ～\n"
en: Cards issued by the Goddess of Wealth. They are apparently aimed at protecting and fostering merchants and promoting economic activity. Yaca points are added according to shop sales and customer traffic. The maximum amount of points is 100,000, so use them in moderation. \n#~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~
en_grezzo: "Cards issued by the Goddess of Wealth. They are apparently aimed at protecting and fostering merchants and promoting economic activity. Yaca points are added according to shop sales and customer traffic. The maximum amount of points is 100,000, so use them in moderation. \n#~Merchant Life Starting from a Quitting as a Adventurer~"
it: La carta che emette la dea della ricchezza. Pare che serva a proteggere e far crescere i mercanti e a dare una spinta all'economia. I YacaPoint si accumulano in base agli incassi del negozio e a quanta gente ci entra. Il tetto è di centomila punti, quindi conviene spenderli ogni tanto. \n#~Vita da Mercante Dopo l'Avventura~

jp: \t\t「毎年１２月はヤカポイント５倍や！年末商戦は計画的に！」\n#～富の女神の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「毎年１２月はヤカポイント５倍や！年末商戦は計画的に！」\n#～富の女神の言葉～\n"
en: \"You get five times the Yaca points every December! Plan your year-end sales!\" \n# Words of the Goddess of Wealth
en_grezzo: "\"You get five times the Yaca points every December! Plan your year-end sales!\" \n# Words of the Goddess of Wealth"
it: \"Ogni anno a dicembre i YacaPoint valgono cinque volte tanto! Le vendite di fine anno organizzatele bene!\" \n# ~Parole della Dea del Tesoro~

jp: \t\t人型に似せて作られた木人。この木人を戦闘相手に見立てて、武器スキルの訓練ができる。\n#～イムウエル幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t人型に似せて作られた木人。この木人を戦闘相手に見立てて、武器スキルの訓練ができる。\n#～イムウエル幻想辞典～\n"
en: A wooden person made to resemble a humanoid. You can train your weapon skills by using this wooden person as a combatant. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A wooden person made to resemble a humanoid. You can train your weapon skills by using this wooden person as a combatant. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una bambola di legno fatta a somiglianza di una figura umana. Prendendola per avversario ci si allena nelle abilità con le armi. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Aimwell~

jp: \t\t「君はあの洞窟でずっと待っていたんだね…帰ってこない主人を何人も、何年も」\n#～ガイドの『ノルン』の言葉～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t「君はあの洞窟でずっと待っていたんだね…帰ってこない主人を何人も、何年も」\n#～ガイドの『ノルン』の言葉～\n"
en: \"You've been waiting in that cave for years... for your master who never returned, for years.\" \n# ~<Norne> the guide~
en_grezzo: "\"You've been waiting in that cave for years... for your master who never returned, for years.\" \n# ~<Norne> the guide~"
it: \"Tu in quella grotta hai aspettato tutto il tempo... padroni che non tornavano, tanti, per anni e anni.\" \n# ~Parole di <Norne> la guida~

jp: \t\t農作業道具の詰め合わせ。作物に成長促進と品質向上をもたらす。特定の品種が有利に育つように作業方法を選び、環境を整える。その都合上、混ざっている他の品種は成長競争に負け養分と化す。作業にはスタミナを消費するので注意。\n#～農業、その新たな可能性～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t農作業道具の詰め合わせ。作物に成長促進と品質向上をもたらす。特定の品種が有利に育つように作業方法を選び、環境を整える。その都合上、混ざっている他の品種は成長競争に負け養分と化す。作業にはスタミナを消費するので注意。\n#～農業、その新たな可能性～\n"
en: Assorted farming tools. Provides growth acceleration and quality improvement to crops. Selects work methods and creates an environment in which certain varieties grow to their advantage. For this reason, other varieties in the mix will lose the growth competition and become nutrients. Note that the work consumes stamina. \n# ~Agriculture and its New Possibilities~
en_grezzo: "Assorted farming tools. Provides growth acceleration and quality improvement to crops. Selects work methods and creates an environment in which certain varieties grow to their advantage. For this reason, other varieties in the mix will lose the growth competition and become nutrients. Note that the work consumes stamina. \n# ~Agriculture and its New Possibilities~"
it: Un assortimento di attrezzi da campo. Fa crescere prima le colture e ne alza la qualità. Si sceglie il modo di lavorare e si prepara il terreno perché una certa varietà cresca avvantaggiata; per questo le altre varietà mescolate perdono la gara e finiscono per farle da concime. Attenzione: il lavoro consuma resistenza. \n# ~L'Agricoltura e le sue Nuove Possibilità~

jp: \t\tなぜかその辺に落ちている、手ごろな大きさの枝。火を起こすことができる。\n#～君にもできるサバイバル～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tなぜかその辺に落ちている、手ごろな大きさの枝。火を起こすことができる。\n#～君にもできるサバイバル～\n"
en: A reasonably sized branch that for some reason has fallen around. It can start a fire. \n# ~Survival that Anyone Can Do~
en_grezzo: "A reasonably sized branch that for some reason has fallen around. It can start a fire. \n# ~Survival that Anyone Can Do~"
it: Un ramo di misura giusta, che chissà come sta lì per terra. Serve ad accendere il fuoco. \n# ~La Sopravvivenza Alla Portata di Tutti~

jp: \t\t手ぶれを抑えたり射撃手や砲架が受ける反動を受け流したりするための固定器具。精密な射撃を可能にする他、反動を気にせず思いっきりぶっ放すことも可能に。オートマチックで地面に突き刺さった後は、一定時間経過すると解除される。その間は逃げることもできないので注意。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t手ぶれを抑えたり射撃手や砲架が受ける反動を受け流したりするための固定器具。精密な射撃を可能にする他、反動を気にせず思いっきりぶっ放すことも可能に。オートマチックで地面に突き刺さった後は、一定時間経過すると解除される。その間は逃げることもできないので注意。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A stabilizing device used to suppress hand shaking and to absorb the recoil received by the shooter and the gun mount. In addition to enabling precise shooting, it also makes it possible to fire with all one's might without worrying about the recoil. Once the automatic weapon is stuck in the ground, it is released after a certain period of time. Note that you cannot escape during this time. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A stabilizing device used to suppress hand shaking and to absorb the recoil received by the shooter and the gun mount. In addition to enabling precise shooting, it also makes it possible to fire with all one's might without worrying about the recoil. Once the automatic weapon is stuck in the ground, it is released after a certain period of time. Note that you cannot escape during this time. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un fermo che tiene ferma la mano e scarica il rinculo che prendono il tiratore e l'affusto. Rende possibile il tiro di precisione, e permette anche di sparare a più non posso senza badare al rinculo. Si pianta a terra da sé, e dopo un certo tempo si sgancia. Attenzione: nel frattempo non si può scappare. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t欲望を煽るように怪しく輝く欠片。そこそこ綺麗なので宝石の代用にされたりもする。使用者にトラップを操る魔力を与え、代償として命を蝕む…というウワサもあるが誰も信じていない。遥か昔に人間を滅ぼそうとして敗れた魔神が、赤い破片となって飛び散ったという伝承があり、そこからこの名がつけられた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t欲望を煽るように怪しく輝く欠片。そこそこ綺麗なので宝石の代用にされたりもする。使用者にトラップを操る魔力を与え、代償として命を蝕む…というウワサもあるが誰も信じていない。遥か昔に人間を滅ぼそうとして敗れた魔神が、赤い破片となって飛び散ったという伝承があり、そこからこの名がつけられた。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Fragments that shine suspiciously to incite desire. Because it is so beautiful, it is sometimes used as a substitute for jewelry. There are rumors that it gives the user the magical power to manipulate traps, and in return, it eats away at one's life... but no one believes it. There is a legend that a long time ago, a demonic god attempting to destroy humanity was defeated and scattered into red fragments, hence the name. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Fragments that shine suspiciously to incite desire. Because it is so beautiful, it is sometimes used as a substitute for jewelry. There are rumors that it gives the user the magical power to manipulate traps, and in return, it eats away at one's life... but no one believes it. There is a legend that a long time ago, a demonic god attempting to destroy humanity was defeated and scattered into red fragments, hence the name. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Un frammento che brilla in modo torbido, come per attizzare il desiderio. È abbastanza bello da servire al posto di una gemma. Gira anche la voce che dia a chi lo usa la forza magica di manovrare le trappole, e che in cambio gli roda la vita... ma non ci crede nessuno. C'è una leggenda per cui, tanto tempo fa, un dio demoniaco che voleva distruggere gli uomini fu sconfitto e si sparse in schegge rosse: di lì gli viene il nome. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t使用者の思念に応じてサイズが変わる伝説の耳かき。妖精だろうが巨人だろうがこれ一本で済むが、適当なことを考えていると制御不能に陥る。使いこなせば全みみくそを一度にまとめて摘出することも可能な逸品なので、ただ修行あるのみ。端に付いているフワフワしたものは人造ケサランパサランであり、使った後はゆっくり休ませないと死ぬ。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n

en: Legendary ear picks that change size according to the user's thoughts. Whether you are a fairy or a giant, you only need one of these, but you will lose control of it if you are thinking about the wrong thing. If you master the use of this masterpiece, you can remove all the earwax at once, so you just have to train yourself. The fluffy thing attached to the end is artificial kesalanpatharan, which will die if it is not allowed to rest slowly after use. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~

it: Il leggendario nettaorecchie che cambia misura secondo il pensiero di chi lo usa. Che tu sia una fata o un gigante ne basta uno, ma se pensi a vanvera ti sfugge di mano. Con la pratica si arriva a cavare tutto il cerume in un colpo solo: è un pezzo pregiato, e non resta che allenarsi. Il batuffolo in punta è un kesaranpasaran artificiale, e dopo l'uso, se non lo si lascia riposare con calma, muore. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tクリスマス用のでかいケーキ。12月になると雑貨店が売り始めるが、売れ残ることも。でかいので皆でお腹いっぱい食べられる。もちろん独り占めすることもできるが、虚しい。12月なら信仰の技術を成長させ幸運も呼ぶ。\n#～ノースティリス紀行・冬版～\n

en: A large Christmas cake, sold at grocery stores in December, but sometimes left unsold. It's so big that everyone can eat a whole lot of it. Of course, you can have it all to yourself, but that's wasteful; in December, you can develop the art of faith and bring good luck by eating it. \n# ~North Tyris Travels, Winter Edition~

it: Un dolce enorme per il Natale. A dicembre le mercerie cominciano a venderlo, ma qualcuno resta invenduto. È grande, e ci si sazia tutti insieme. Certo, uno può anche tenerselo per sé, ma che tristezza. A dicembre fa crescere l'abilità Fede e porta anche fortuna. \n# ~Viaggio in Tyris del Nord: Inverno~

jp: \t\tガチョウを抱えたヤカテクトの人形。神公式の工場で製造されているらしい。金貨を入れると翼を動かしながら喋る。入れた金貨はヤカテクトに運用され、トワリならぬヒャクワリ…およそ１００日で１割の利子がつく。高利と引き換えに１００日目まで出し入れはできないし、以降は追加預金しないと利子が増えないという制約がある。そして取り出す際は金貨が尻から出る。もちろんガチョウの。\n#～必見！貯蓄型資産運用のすべて～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tガチョウを抱えたヤカテクトの人形。神公式の工場で製造されているらしい。金貨を入れると翼を動かしながら喋る。入れた金貨はヤカテクトに運用され、トワリならぬヒャクワリ…およそ１００日で１割の利子がつく。高利と引き換えに１００日目まで出し入れはできないし、以降は追加預金しないと利子が増えないという制約がある。そして取り出す際は金貨が尻から出る。もちろんガチョウの。\n#～必見！貯蓄型資産運用のすべて～\n"
en: Plushie of Yacatect holding a goose. It is said to be manufactured at the God's official factory. When gold coins are inserted, it speaks and moves its wings. The gold coins are invested by Yacatect, and generate interest at a rate of 10% per 100 days. In exchange for the high interest rate, the coins cannot be taken out until the 100th day, and after that, the interest will not increase unless additional deposits are made. And when you take it out, a gold coin comes out of its butt. The goose's butt, of course. \n# ~Must Watch! Everything About Savings and Asset Management~
en_grezzo: "Plushie of Yacatect holding a goose. It is said to be manufactured at the God's official factory. When gold coins are inserted, it speaks and moves its wings. it: Un pupazzo di Yacatect che tiene in braccio un'oca. Pare che lo facciano in una fabbrica ufficiale degli dei. Se ci metti dentro monete d'oro, muove le ali e parla. Le monete le fa fruttare Yacatect: non al decimo giorno, ma al centesimo... un decimo di interesse ogni cento giorni circa. In cambio del tasso alto non si può né mettere né togliere fino al centesimo giorno, e dopo gli interessi non crescono se non si versa altro. E quando le tiri fuori, le monete escono dal sedere. Dell'oca, s'intende. \n# ~Da Vedere! Tutto sul Risparmio e sugli Investimenti~

jp: \t\t血ぬられた小太刀。切腹して詫びながら果てた武士の思念が残っており、握っていると自然と腹に刃が向かう。謝罪する際に使うと相手に本気が伝わると評判。土下座よりもはるかに謝罪力が高く、敵対している相手にもしばらく見逃してもらえる。すぐ手当すれば死にはしない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t血ぬられた小太刀。切腹して詫びながら果てた武士の思念が残っており、握っていると自然と腹に刃が向かう。謝罪する際に使うと相手に本気が伝わると評判。土下座よりもはるかに謝罪力が高く、敵対している相手にもしばらく見逃してもらえる。すぐ手当すれば死にはしない。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Bloodstained kodachi, a small dagger. It contains the thoughts of warriors who committed seppuku (ritual suicide) and died with an apology, and when held, the blade will naturally aim at your stomach. When used to apologize, it is reputed to convey one's true intentions to the other party. It has much more apologetic power than the \"Kneeling on the Ground\" method, and even enemies will let you off the hook for a while. If treated immediately, it will not kill you. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~

it: Una spada corta insanguinata. Ci resta addosso il pensiero dei guerrieri che se ne sono andati col seppuku, chiedendo scusa, e a tenerla in mano la lama va da sola verso la pancia. Dicono che usarla per scusarsi faccia arrivare all'altro quanto sei serio. Come forza di scusa vale molto più di un inchino a terra, e perfino chi ti è nemico ti lascia in pace per un po'. Se ci si medica subito non si muore. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\tネフィアへと繋がる龍脈を操作し、ネフィアの難度を変化させる宝玉。決戦因子候補の成長に合わせて調整するためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\tネフィアへと繋がる龍脈を操作し、ネフィアの難度を変化させる宝玉。決戦因子候補の成長に合わせて調整するためのもの。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: Treasure that manipulates the dragon vein leading to Nefia and changes the difficulty level of Nefia. Designed to adjust to the growth of the decisive factor candidate. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "Treasure that manipulates the dragon vein leading to Nefia and changes the difficulty level of Nefia. Designed to adjust to the growth of the decisive factor candidate. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una gemma che manovra la vena del drago che porta alle Nefia e ne cambia la difficoltà. Serve a regolarla man mano che cresce chi è candidato a Fattore Decisivo. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t存在に耐え切れず砕けた星の欠片。不思議な深い青色の光を放つ。屑扱いされたりもするが、やがて巡り巡って別の星の礎になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t存在に耐え切れず砕けた星の欠片。不思議な深い青色の光を放つ。屑扱いされたりもするが、やがて巡り巡って別の星の礎になる。\n#～イルヴァ幻想辞典～\n"
en: A piece of shattered star. They emit a mysterious deep blue light. They are just dust at the beginning, and eventually they will become the foundation of another star. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~
en_grezzo: "A piece of shattered star. They emit a mysterious deep blue light. They are just dust at the beginning, and eventually they will become the foundation of another star. \n# ~Irva Fantasy Encyclopedia~"
it: Una scheggia di stella che si è spezzata non reggendo più a esistere. Manda una luce azzurra e cupa, misteriosa. C'è chi la tratta da scarto, ma prima o poi, girando di mano in mano, diventa la base di un'altra stella. \n# ~Dizionario Fantastico di Irva~

jp: \t\t生化学文明時代の禁忌の装置。構成材料を対象から無理矢理採取して高速培養、三次元スキャンデータを元に複製人間を作り出す。現代では専用の材料転送設備が残存していないため、命が宿らずガワだけの肉塊になってしまうし、装置自体も実質使い捨て。それでも一部のマニアの間ではく製メーカーとして使われている。本人に無断で使うと怒られるので気をつけよう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t生化学文明時代の禁忌の装置。構成材料を対象から無理矢理採取して高速培養、三次元スキャンデータを元に複製人間を作り出す。現代では専用の材料転送設備が残存していないため、命が宿らずガワだけの肉塊になってしまうし、装置自体も実質使い捨て。それでも一部のマニアの間ではく製メーカーとして使われている。本人に無断で使うと怒られるので気をつけよう。\n#～別冊ヨウィン・未知の知識を追え！～\n"
en: Forbidden device in the era of biochemical civilization. It forcibly extracts the constituent materials from the subject, cultivates them at high speed, and creates a duplicate human being based on the scan data. Since there are no dedicated material transfer facilities left today, the human is reduced to a lump of flesh with no life in it, and the device itself is practically disposable. It is still used by some enthusiasts as a fabricator. Be careful not to use it without the person's permission, as it will make them angry. \n# ~The Yowyn Book of Secrt Knowledge!~

it: L'apparecchio proibito dell'età della civiltà biochimica. Strappa a forza dal soggetto la materia che lo compone, la fa crescere in fretta e, sui dati di una scansione in tre dimensioni, ne cava una copia umana. Oggi gli impianti che trasferivano la materia non ci sono più, quindi ne esce solo un pezzo di carne senza vita dentro, e l'apparecchio stesso è di fatto usa e getta. Con tutto ciò, fra certi appassionati va come macchina per statuette. Attenzione: se lo usi su qualcuno senza il suo permesso, si arrabbia. \n# ~Speciale Yowyn: a Caccia del Sapere Ignoto!~

jp: \t\t使い捨ての研磨剤や補修材、細工道具をまとめたもの。説明書付き。少数の丘の民が細々と販売している。目に見えないほどの細かい破損やズレを修復し、武具の性能を最大限に引き出す。さすがに激しい錆などはお手上げなので別の方法を考えよう。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n
jp_grezzo: "\t\t使い捨ての研磨剤や補修材、細工道具をまとめたもの。説明書付き。少数の丘の民が細々と販売している。目に見えないほどの細かい破損やズレを修復し、武具の性能を最大限に引き出す。さすがに激しい錆などはお手上げなので別の方法を考えよう。\n#～いいもの選ぼう職人道具～\n"
en: A collection of disposable abrasives, repair materials, and crafting tools. Comes with instructions. Sold in small quantities by a small number of hill people. Repairing invisible minor damages and misalignments to maximize the performance of the armor. As expected, heavy rust and the like cannot be helped, and we will need some other method. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~
en_grezzo: "A collection of disposable abrasives, repair materials, and crafting tools. Comes with instructions. Sold in small quantities by a small number of hill people. Repairing invisible minor damages and misalignments to maximize the performance of the armor. As expected, heavy rust and the like cannot be helped, and we will need some other method. \n# ~Choosing the Best Tools for the Best Craftsmen~"
it: Un insieme di paste abrasive usa e getta, materiali da riparo e attrezzi da lavoro fine. Con le istruzioni. Lo vende in piccola quantità un pugno di gente delle colline. Ripara le rotture e gli scarti minimi, quelli che l'occhio non vede, e tira fuori il meglio da armi e armature. Contro una ruggine forte non c'è niente da fare: meglio cercare un'altra strada. \n# ~Scegliere Bene gli Attrezzi da Artigiano~

jp: \t\tたまに遺跡から専用の火薬玉と一緒に見つかる筒。殺傷力を重視していないこと、真上にしか撃てないことから、専門家は当時における信号弾ではないかと考えている。爆発がなかなか綺麗なため、近年では祭りの際に観賞用として使われることがある。\n#～古代道具の謎に迫る！～\n

en: A cylinder that is sometimes found in archaeological sites along with a special gunpowder ball. Because it does not emphasize killing power, and it can only be shot straight up, experts believe that it may have been a signal bullet in those days. Because the explosion is quite beautiful, it is sometimes used as an ornamental object during festivals in recent years. \n# ~Mystery of the Ancient Tools!~

it: Un tubo che ogni tanto si trova nelle rovine insieme alle sue palle di polvere. Visto che non punta a ferire e che spara solo dritto in alto, gli esperti pensano fosse un razzo di segnale dell'epoca. Lo scoppio è piuttosto bello, e negli ultimi anni lo si usa alle feste per far spettacolo. \n# ~All'Inseguimento del Mistero degli Arnesi Antichi!~

It contains ingredients thats beneficial to the skin, and activate brain cells, and make it possible to tolerate light sleepiness. However, there is a risk of addiction, so use in moderation. \n# ~Sickly Taste of Smoke~
en_grezzo: "A variant of the smoking pipe. In contrast to the pipe, the smoke is inhaled in a single breath without the use of flavoring. it: Una variante della pipa da fumo. Al contrario della pipa, il fumo si tira tutto in un fiato, senza aromi. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Carisma, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

jp: \t\t木製の喫煙具。タバコの葉を刻んで詰めるのだが、そこに薬草等の香料をブレンドして楽しむ。紙巻に比べるとゆっくりとタバコを味わうのに向いている。習得を成長させる成分が含まれているほか、脳細胞が活性化し、軽い眠気に耐えられるようになる。ただし依存症になる危険性があるのでほどほどに。\n#～病みつきになる煙の味は～\n

Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~

it: Foglia di tabacco arrotolata a tubo. In origine la punta si taglia con una lama, ma per chi ha poca voglia l'hanno lavorata in modo da poterla staccare a mano. Contiene sostanze che fanno crescere l'attributo Destrezza, e in più risveglia le cellule del cervello, così si regge un po' di sonnolenza. Attento però: c'è il rischio di prenderci il vizio, quindi con moderazione. \n# ~Il Sapore del Fumo che Dà Dipendenza~
